name: Weld County, CO
findings: Weld County has 942 nonprofit organizations. 400 of them (42%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 308 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Weld County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Youth organizations stand out for public events
observations.text: 17 youth organizations here list public events, compared with about 8 in similar places of this size.

confidence.text: Based on 17 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.text: 70 religious organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.
